trap-nonspeakable.notes: RIGOR (reported, not fixed - MAJOR, the braid word is wrong and every character in the block depends on it). (1) THE WORD GIVEN IS NOT THE FIGURE-EIGHT BRAID; ITS CLOSURE IS THE UNKNOT. The statement writes '4_1 = sigma_0 sigma_1^{-1} sigma_0^{-1} sigma_1', i.e. (0-indexed on 3 strands) the COMMUTATOR sigma_1 sigma_2^{-1} sigma_1^{-1} sigma_2. Cyclic permutation gives sigma_2^{-1} sigma_1^{-1} sigma_2 sigma_1, and the braid relation sigma_1^{-1} sigma_2 sigma_1 = sigma_2 sigma_1 sigma_2^{-1} reduces it to sigma_1 sigma_2^{-1}; two Markov destabilisations then give the UNKNOT. The figure-eight knot is the closure of (sigma_1 sigma_2^{-1})^2 - the word that the sibling block rem:figure-8-archimedean-illustration correctly gives. (2) THE TABULATED CHARACTER CONFIRMS IT IS THE WRONG BRAID, NOT JUST A TYPO. Building the 2-dimensional [2,1] Hoefsmit representation explicitly in sympy (A = diag(q,-1/q), B solved from B^2 = hB + I and ABA = BAB, braid relation verified): chi_{[2,1]}(sigma_1 sigma_2^{-1} sigma_1^{-1} sigma_2) = -q^2 + 1 - q^{-2} = -1 - h^2, which is EXACTLY Table 1's entry; whereas chi_{[2,1]}((sigma_1 sigma_2^{-1})^2) = q^4 - 2q^2 + 1 - 2q^{-2} + q^{-4}, which is not. (chi(sigma_1 sigma_2^{-1}) is also -1 - h^2, confirming the conjugacy.) So Table 1, the b_lambda = -f^{lambda/[2,1]} h^2 correction, and every BW assignment in Table 2 are characters of a braid whose closure is the unknot, presented as the figure-eight. The classical part is unaffected (both words map to a 3-cycle in S_3, and chi_{[2,1]}((123)) = -1). Proposed: decide which object the chapter means - if the figure-eight, recompute Table 1 with (sigma_1 sigma_2^{-1})^2 and propagate; if the commutator, stop calling it 4_1. Also index the generators from 1 (sigma_1, sigma_2), not sigma_0. (3) VERIFIED CORRECT: '191 partitions at k = 3 through k = 11' is exactly p(3)+...+p(11) = 3+5+7+11+15+22+30+42+56 = 191. (4) NO-FLOAT64 / wording: 'Verified to machine precision (< 10^{-12})' - 10^{-12} is not machine precision (~10^{-16}); state the dps or say 'to the limit of the arithmetic used'. (5) SS7c: the hypothesis 'substrate parameter q > 1' is an archimedean ordering condition on a claim that is a Laurent-polynomial identity; it can be dropped to a generic coefficient ring.
